lines.zh: 我提着灯走，火在里头晃。
lines.en: I walk with my lamp. The flame sways inside.

lines.zh: 小小的身子，挪得慢悠悠。
lines.en: A small body. Slow, unhurried steps.
My wick brightens, then dims.
This lamp of mine was alchemized.
My light sits in the puddles at my feet.
Each step swings the lamp.

lines.zh: 这盏灯是为远航的人点的。
lines.en: This lamp burns for those far at sea.
Strolling. In no hurry.

lines.zh: 灯油还有一半，能走远些。
lines.en: Half a lamp's oil left. I can go far.
I light my own shadow.
I go around the rocks. I fear the flame dying.
Strong wind. I shield the flame with my body.
I walk as if searching for something.
Small prints of mine in the sand.
The lamp shows the way. I don't get lost.
I head toward the lighthouse.
The lamp still burns. So I'm still here.

lines.zh: 我站在礁石上，替人指路。
lines.en: I stand on the reef, marking the way.
The flame jumps inside me.

lines.zh: 海风把我的光晃得很散。
lines.en: Sea wind scatters my light.
Oil's low. I count the drops.

lines.zh: 这盏灯是伊比利亚的样式。
lines.en: An Iberian style lamp.
I hear waves. And a ship.
Condensation on the glass. Can't wipe it off.
I stand like this, waiting for the tide.
A ship's light far off. Brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，让光扫过水面。
lines.en: I sway so the light sweeps the water.

lines.zh: 我里面有一点海的咸味。
lines.en: There's a hint of salt inside me.
No ship yet. I keep standing.
I stay still. The flame might go out.
Are you lost?
My light only reaches your feet.
You have to bend to see me.
My wick leans your way.
Are you looking for a shore too?

lines.zh: 我这么小，你却停下来了。
lines.en: I'm this small, and you stopped.

lines.zh: 你的脸被我的火照黄了。
lines.en: My flame paints your face yellow.

lines.zh: 远航灯亮着，船就不会偏。
lines.en: While the voyage lamp burns, no ship drifts.

lines.zh: 别把灯夺走，那会要我的命。
lines.en: Don't take the lamp. That would be the end of me.
I light you, and you say nothing.
Don't douse me. The flame.
A crack in the glass.
Wobbling badly. Oil's about to spill.
I'm backing off. Don't follow.
That made my flame shrink.
Still burning. That's something.
Pain isn't something a lamp knows well.
The crack leaks light.
You knocked me a full spin.
One more and I go out.
Oil! Is that oil in your hand?

lines.zh: 给我添一点，我就能多走一程。
lines.en: Top me up and I'll walk a while longer.

lines.zh: 灯芯渴了，你听见它响吗？
lines.en: My wick is thirsty. Hear it crackle?
Not food, but I want it.
Pour a little. Don't spill it.
The flame shot up.

lines.zh: 你举着灯油，我眼睛都亮了。
lines.en: You're holding oil and my whole face lights.
Give it and step back. Sparks fly.

lines.zh: 有了这壶，我能撑到天亮。
lines.en: With that flask I'll last till dawn.

lines.zh: 你别一次全倒，我会烧过头。
lines.en: Don't pour it all. I'd flare too high.
Don't step on me. The glass breaks.
I step back. The flame tilts.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，灯里的油晃了。
lines.en: You bumped me. The oil sloshed.
A lamp this low gets bumped. Expected.
I pass along your feet.
The flame held. Lucky.

lines.zh: 你脚边有个小东西，是我。
lines.en: Something small by your foot. That's me.
A light bump, but I fear the dark.

lines.zh: 我把灯往另一边偏，躲你。
lines.en: I tilt the lamp away from you.

lines.zh: 要是灯灭了，我就走不动。
lines.en: If the flame dies, I can't move.
I'm a lamp, not a living thing.
Another lamp? Maybe out at sea.
My flame lights only one person.
Hold me? You'd burn your hands.
My flame doesn't reach that far.

lines.zh: 灯芯晃了晃，你离我的火远些。
lines.en: My wick flickers. Keep away from my flame.
The flame is for burning on its own.
Step back. I fear you'd put me out.
I light the road, not hearts.
Windy here. Stand farther.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块，塞不进灯里。
lines.en: I pick something up. It won't fit in the lamp.
Smell of lamp oil. Got it.
I cup it in both small hands.
This stone gleams a little in my light.
Dropped on the ground. I'll mind it.
I hold it by the flame to see.
So small I nearly lost it.
It won't burn. A shame.
I tuck it beside the lamp base.
I sniff it. It's from the sea.
Something moved in the dark.
My light found you.
Which way did you come from?

lines.zh: 我只有这么点光，也够看。
lines.en: This little light is enough to see.
You're not here for the road.
My wick leans your way.

lines.zh: 我把灯举高，看清你的手。
lines.en: Lamp raised. Let me see your hands.

lines.zh: 你踩到的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard what you stepped on.
This lamp can serve as a weapon.
You're standing outside my circle of light.
I aim the flame at you.
You retreat. The light follows.
The oil sloshes. Quickly.
I'm small. I'm also hot.
One more step and I pour the oil.
My light doesn't reach all of you.
You're hesitating at the edge of my light.

lines.zh: 小灯笼压低，照着你脚边的礁石。
lines.en: I lower my lamp, lighting the reef by your feet.
Only one path here.

lines.zh: 火苗朝你那边偏得很厉害。
lines.en: The flame bends hard toward you.
I lunge and the flame licks you.
Hot oil splashes out, hissing.
My rim hits your ankle.
That cost me a chip of glass.
You back off. Your trouser leg is singed.
I swing the whole lamp at you.
One flash and your eyes blur.
That blow rocked me too.
Don't stamp me out. Please.

lines.zh: 我把灯油全泼出去了，认得这个味吧。
lines.en: I threw all my oil. Recognize the smell?
Someone lit me and set me on the shore.
A small lamp lit on the sand.

lines.zh: 我的火先是蓝的，然后变黄。
lines.en: My flame started blue, then went yellow.

lines.zh: 我提着小灯，从退潮的滩涂亮起。
lines.en: I light up on the ebb flats, a small lamp in hand.
I light the black water. On and on.
Droplets still hang on my glass.
The wind bent me over once.

lines.zh: 我亮起来，是因为有人需要。
lines.en: I lit because someone needed light.
Someone far off saw me.
The sand beneath me is wet.

lines.zh: 火烧灯罩，我分不清内外了。
lines.en: Fire on the glass. Inside and out feel the same.
Dropped. The base chipped.
Water over my mouth. The flame screams.
The blast blew my glass away.
A small hole punched through the glass.

lines.zh: 火不应这个，它开始乱了。
lines.en: The flame doesn't answer to that. It's going wild.
Oil's gone. The flame is a sliver.
Lightning is far brighter than my lamp.
Falling, and the flame still burns.
